The customer picks a stablecoin they hold and pays the route cost on top. Returns url to share. A single-use link closes

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: Read one of your payment links: its status, amount, url, and its most recent payments. Fulfill an order only when its payment is PAID. Available only while GET https://api.pay.axiv.cc/v1/capabilities reports paymentLinks true. Check that first. While it is false the payment API answers PAYMENT_LINKS

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read this month's completed payment volume, the free allowance left, Axiv fees charged, and your request limits. Takes no arguments. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_payment_link, get_payment_link · Private data: get_payment_status, check_payment_route, create_quote, create_payment, get_funding_step, submit_funding_transaction, create_payment_link, get_payment_link, get_usage · Public sink: get_payment_status, create_quote, create_payment, get_funding_step, submit_funding_transaction, create_payment_link, get_payment_link, get_usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_payment_link, get_payment_link · Private data: get_payment_status, check_payment_route, create_quote, create_payment, get_funding_step, submit_funding_transaction, create_payment_link, get_payment_link, get_usage · Public sink: get_payment_status, create_quote, create_payment, get_funding_step, submit_funding_transaction, create_payment_link, get_payment_link, get_usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
